info.desc: Death Certificate is the second studio album by rapper Ice Cube, released October 31, 1991 on Priority Records. Highly anticipated with over a million advance orders, the album was certified platinum in sales on December 20, 1991. The album debuted on the Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart at #1 and on the Billboard 200 chart at #2, while it went on to sell over two million copies to date. podcast.body: This 1991 album reached number 1 on the charts and featured the "vicious diss track" "No Vaseline," recorded in response to lyrical digs from his former N.W.A. bandmates, Dr. Dre and Eazy-E. The album's success further solidified Ice Cube's solo career after his departure from N.W.A. "This prompted Ice Cubes to record the vicious, distrac, no-vacillian, a deep cut from his 1991 number 1 solo album, Death Certificate."
